【原视频简介】
I gave Gemini 3.8 Flash one ridiculous challenge..

BUILD MINECRAFT. (In less than 10 prompts..)

And somehow… it actually made a better playable Minecraft-style game.

Want to play this game? Go here 👉 https://dub.sh/DvYQh74

This isn’t just a static Three.js demo. Gemini 3.8 Flash generated an explorable voxel world with different terrain, tools, inventory, health, hunger, animals, NPCs, villages, a minimap, resources and actual gameplay systems.

In this video, I’m showing you exactly what Gemini 3.8 Flash built, what worked, what broke, and just how far AI-generated games have come.

And yes — I actually played it.

🔥 Gemini 3.8 Flash just launched, and after seeing all the coding demos people were posting, I wanted to push it into something much bigger.

Could Gemini actually recreate the feeling of Minecraft from a prompt?

The result surprised me.

🔔 Subscribe to ByteForward:
https://dub.sh/bytefwd

👀 or my other channel 
https://www.youtube.com/@UCebDC-sIv9nMKSP-8FN7zGw

WHAT GEMINI BUILT

• Playable voxel world
• Procedural terrain
• Multiple biomes
• Minecraft-style tools
• Inventory / hotbar
• Health system
• Hunger system
• Animals
• NPC villagers…
